_comment: Home page chips and cards (owner-named chips, 2026-09-09). A chip with no cards shows an empty card row and leaves the window on whatever was playing. Card titles/blurbs are copied verbatim from CityAnatomyAustin/src/content/copy.ts; the owner writes all copy. src is loaded into the map window. (The YouTube playlist embed under Media was removed 2026-09-09 - owner: not really working.) A chip may carry its own src (News Feed -> /news/): with no cards, picking the chip loads that page in the window. A chip may carry from: a URL of apps/reports/reports.json shape; home.js turns each report into a card that opens /apps/reports/<id>/storymap/ (the same page the reports page opens).
